g.text: Fewer provider calls do not establish more successful requests
Bands: three-run min–max, not confidence intervals. Lines are not a matched pair.
Across three runs: success 89.3% → 66.5%; outside-outage success 100% → 88.7% (medians).
Recovery 5 → 10 s; C4 fail-fast outcomes 200 per 600 jobs (medians).
C4 HARMFUL: outside-success checks fail; recovery round 2 takes 11 s, exceeding its 10 s limit.
